item.title: Item7Go and the Creeping Struggle to Retain What Makes It Unique and Hotly Demanded
item.dc:creator: Redd Penn
item.description: There are businesses that sell products, and there are businesses that become part of people’s everyday lives. Item7Go has, for a while, managed to do both.
